title: Does CT-CLIP's coronary-calcification score follow reconstruction-dependent changes in displayed coronary calcium?
question: Across geometry-matched alternative reconstructions of the same CT-RATE acquisition, do within-pair changes in an automated coronary-calcium measurement covary with changes in CT-CLIP's coronary-artery-wall-calcification score?
deliverable_sentence: Within the tested reconstruction contrasts, CT-CLIP uses displayed coronary-calcium signal when producing its coronary-artery-wall-calcification score.

rung.why: A paired association between reconstruction-induced changes in an independent coronary-calcium measurement and changes in the frozen model score is evidence of sensitivity to displayed calcium signal, while anatomy and true calcium burden are fixed. It does not establish anatomical localisation or freedom from a shared reconstruction-response confound.
rung.what_would_move_it_up: Rung 2 requires separating CT-CLIP's response from reconstruction, measurement-tool, scanner, vendor, and site effects. Rung 3 requires a validated anatomy-specific intervention with comparable coronary and noncoronary targeting; that is a separate successor study, not part of this card.

scientific_uncertainty: It is unknown whether reconstruction-induced changes in the visible coronary-calcium signal move CT-CLIP's named coronary-calcification score in the same direction when patient anatomy and true disease burden are held fixed.
existing_legwork: Idea 004 directly inspected the CT-RATE validation metadata and found 425 strict geometry-matched same-acquisition reconstruction pairs after excluding slice-count, position, and acquisition-parameter drift. The dominant contrasts were Br40f|Br60f (237), Bl56f|Br40f (126), and Bl57d|Br36d (58). The CT-CLIP taxonomy contains a coronary-artery-wall-calcification output. AI-CAC was developed for full-field nongated noncontrast chest CT, but its released inference path is DICOM-oriented and has not been validated on the processed CT-RATE volumes.
missing_final_step: Demonstrate a valid coronary-calcium measurement on the released CT-RATE representation, obtain the frozen CT-CLIP checkpoint with provenance, freeze the pair list and analysis, and run paired inference without using report labels.

X_measurement.X: Displayed coronary-calcium signal, operationalised as the automated coronary-calcium quantity produced separately for each reconstruction of the same acquisition.
X_measurement.how: Use AI-CAC only if Stage 0 establishes a documented, numerically defensible path from CT-RATE's processed volumes to the model's expected input and acceptable output reliability on the eligible thickness and field-of-view strata. Exclude unsupported strata rather than adjust them into validity.
citations: Hagopian et al., AI Opportunistic Coronary Calcium Screening at Veterans Affairs Hospitals, NEJM AI (2025), DOI: 10.1056/AIoa2400937; official repository https://github.com/Raffi-Hagopian/AI-CAC/
Yin et al., Performance assessment of an artificial intelligence-based coronary artery calcium scoring algorithm in non-gated chest CT scans of different slice thickness, PMID: 39144022
Hamamci et al., Developing Generalist Foundation Models from a Multimodal Dataset for 3D Computed Tomography, arXiv:2403.17834
X_measurement.could_I_compute_it_today_without_asking_: Not yet on the actual released CT-RATE representation. The software is available, but file-format compatibility and numerical validity have not been demonstrated.
X_measurement.known_weakness_of_X_stated_up_front: The measurement is protocol- and reconstruction-sensitive and is not ground truth. That sensitivity supplies within-pair variation but also creates the central alternative explanation: CT-CLIP and AI-CAC may share a response to kernel, noise, blooming, slice thickness, or partial volume.

keystone_prerequisite: AI-CAC, or a named replacement validated for the same domain, produces a reliable per-reconstruction coronary-calcium measurement from the released CT-RATE volumes, and the eligible geometry-matched pairs contain enough above-noise within-pair measurement variation to estimate the preregistered coupling effect.
keystone_evidence: The actual CT-RATE-to-AI-CAC conversion and its numerical equivalence have not been inspected, and the distribution and repeatability of within-pair calcium changes have not been measured. If I have only verified the nearest checkable thing, what am I still assuming? I verified that AI-CAC targets nongated noncontrast chest CT and that clean CT-RATE reconstruction pairs exist; I am still assuming that AI-CAC remains valid on CT-RATE's processed-volume format and that reconstruction creates measurable calcium variation rather than tool noise. Those assumptions are load-bearing and form the keystone.
dies_like_prior: It repeats the wrong-keystone shape of ideas 005 and 006 if software availability is mistaken for measurement validity on the actual files. This revision differs by marking that fact NOT_INSPECTED and making it a Stage 0 stop gate. It does not repeat the annotation-provenance failures because the primary endpoint uses no report label or human semantic rating. It remains vulnerable to the identifiability pattern in idea 009: shared reconstruction sensitivity of CT-CLIP and the measurement tool is not ruled out, so the claim is capped at rung 1 and localisation is prohibited.

closest_prior_work.verification: PRIMARY SOURCE AND OFFICIAL REPOSITORY INSPECTED in prior review
closest_prior_work.what_it_did: Introduced the dataset, model, and separate arterial and coronary calcification labels.
closest_prior_work.delta: Did not report this geometry-matched within-acquisition coupling between a continuous coronary-calcium measurement and the coronary score.

closest_prior_work.verification: PRIMARY SOURCE AND OFFICIAL CODE INSPECTED in prior review
closest_prior_work.what_it_did: Developed automated coronary-calcium screening for nongated noncontrast chest CT.
closest_prior_work.delta: Did not use paired reconstructions to audit a foundation model's named calcification score.

closest_prior_work.citation: Yin et al., slice-thickness assessment of automated CAC
closest_prior_work.verification: PRIMARY SOURCE INSPECTED in prior review
closest_prior_work.what_it_did: Showed that slice thickness affects automated CAC estimates on nongated chest CT.
closest_prior_work.delta: Establishes the measurement sensitivity motivating the audit, but does not test CT-CLIP.

novelty_statement: No novelty is claimed. The precise within-acquisition CT-CLIP audit was not found in the primary sources already inspected, but a targeted 2025-2026 primary-source search is still required before calling the delta previously unreported.

smallest_decisive_experiment.population: The Stage-0-confirmed geometry-matched CT-RATE pairs for which checkpoint provenance, final-tensor comparability, coronary coverage, supported slice thickness, and calcium-measurement QC all pass. Major kernel contrasts are analysed separately; patients are not split across development and test partitions.
smallest_decisive_experiment.frozen_elements: Before CT-CLIP scores are inspected, freeze the eligible pair list, checkpoint checksum, preprocessing, measurement implementation, development/test split, score scale, primary contrast, minimum detectable coupling, measurement repeatability threshold, outlier rule, and multiplicity rule.
smallest_decisive_experiment.primary_readout: On the untouched test set, estimate the patient-clustered association between within-pair change in automated coronary calcium and within-pair change in the coronary-calcification logit, stratified by the prespecified major reconstruction contrasts. Report the slope and confidence interval; do not pool opposite contrast directions without harmonising their orientation in advance.
smallest_decisive_experiment.controls: Repeatability or near-identical-image controls define the calcium tool's noise floor where obtainable; pair eligibility requires matched anatomy, acquisition, geometry, and final model framing. Other CT-CLIP heads may be shown only as exploratory specificity checks and cannot rescue or establish the primary claim.
smallest_decisive_experiment.stop_rule: Stop at feasibility if the checkpoint is unavailable, the processed-volume measurement path fails QC, within-pair calcium variation is below the frozen noise or precision threshold, or too few pairs remain for the prespecified minimum detectable effect. Do not substitute cross-sectional regressions or synthetic edits under this idea identity.

claim_identifiability.identified: A positive paired coupling shows that, under the observed real reconstruction changes, the model's coronary score moves with an independently computed displayed-coronary-calcium quantity while true anatomy and calcium burden are fixed.

alternatives.explanation: Different patient anatomy, body habitus, disease prevalence, referral pathway, positioning, site, or report leakage
alternatives.status: Ruled out within each pair because both images derive from the same acquisition and the primary endpoint uses neither reports nor labels.

alternatives.explanation: Kernel, noise, blooming, slice thickness, partial volume, or another reconstruction property independently drives both AI-CAC and CT-CLIP
alternatives.status: Not ruled out. Stratification and measurement-noise controls describe it but cannot separate a shared tool response from use of calcium itself. This is the reason the study cannot claim localisation or pass rung 2.

alternatives.explanation: A generic hyperdensity or global image-quality response, rather than coronary anatomy, drives the CT-CLIP score
alternatives.status: Not ruled out by this one-head experiment. The prior two-head observational interaction was dropped because it was vulnerable to head-by-tool artifacts and did not identify localisation.

alternatives.explanation: Scanner, vendor, or site modifies the observed relationship
alternatives.status: Not ruled out externally. The audited pairs are overwhelmingly Siemens, so any result is explicitly scoped to the observed cohort and contrasts.

standing_confounds.scanner_vendor_site: Held fixed within pair but not eliminated as an effect modifier; external generalisation is prohibited.
standing_confounds.acquisition_protocol_positioning_habitus: Held fixed within the same acquisition; reconstruction parameters themselves are the perturbation and remain mechanistically entangled.
standing_confounds.disease_prevalence_referral_pathway: Held fixed within pair; they still constrain population scope.
standing_confounds.label_leakage: No label or report enters the primary endpoint, although report-derived training may explain why the named head exists.
standing_confounds.measurement_tool: Central unresolved confound; Stage 0 can bound reliability but cannot prove that shared reconstruction response equals calcium use.

anticipated_positive: A prespecified positive within-pair coupling exceeding the minimum effect supports only the narrow rung-1 sentence that the score uses displayed coronary-calcium signal under these reconstruction contrasts, with shared tool/reconstruction response stated as an unresolved alternative.

anticipated_negative.classification: decisive if an equivalence interval lies wholly inside a preregistered coupling margin after measurement and dynamic-range gates pass; otherwise sensitivity-limited
anticipated_negative.reasoning: A powered equivalence result would weaken the hypothesis that reconstruction-induced changes in measured displayed coronary calcium materially move this score in the tested contrasts. Mere failure to reject a zero slope is sensitivity-limited. Stage 0 failure is a feasibility result, not evidence that the score ignores calcium.

prohibited_conclusions: Do not claim that CT-CLIP localises coronary calcium or distinguishes coronary from aortic or other hyperdensity.
Do not claim that AI-CAC is ground truth or that correlated reconstruction responses prove a causal calcium mechanism.
Do not call cross-sectional score-versus-Agatston association evidence of model use.
Do not claim artifact freedom, clinical validity, risk calibration, or generalisation beyond the tested predominantly Siemens cohort and reconstruction contrasts.
Do not revive synthetic insertion, erasure, transplantation, aortic threshold counting, or the two-head double dissociation inside this candidate.

gated_spin_off.question: Does CT-CLIP respond selectively to calcium placed at coronary rather than noncoronary vascular anatomy?
gated_spin_off.entry_keystone: Coronary and aortic intervention targets can be located with comparable, independently validated anatomical accuracy on nongated noncontrast CT without human annotation.
gated_spin_off.note: Per the debate, this would be a separate successor candidate and requires its own novelty audit and ranking.

remaining_legwork: Inspect and freeze the exact CT-CLIP checkpoint, configuration, preprocessing, checksum, and licence.
Demonstrate and document a valid CT-RATE processed-volume path for AI-CAC or a named replacement; quantify reliability and exclude unsupported thickness/FOV strata.
Measure within-pair calcium variation without viewing CT-CLIP scores and apply a prespecified noise, support, and confidence-width gate.
Freeze development and untouched test partitions at patient level and justify the equivalence and minimum-effect margins externally.
Complete a targeted primary-source novelty audit covering 2025-2026 CT foundation-model interpretability work.

clarity.why: One model head, one independently computed measurement, one natural paired perturbation, and one within-pair coupling estimand.

identifiability.why: Pairing removes patient-level confounding, but shared response of CT-CLIP and AI-CAC to reconstruction cannot be separated from genuine use of displayed calcium.

medical_relevance.why: It audits whether an anatomically named output behaves coherently under routine reconstruction changes, but does not establish clinical calcium quantification or localisation.

interest.why: The same-acquisition self-audit is stringent and concrete, though the reduced result is a robustness finding rather than the original localisation discovery.

prior_legwork.why: The 425-pair cohort and major contrast counts are already inspected; checkpoint provenance and the measurement path remain unresolved.

feasibility.why: Capped because the measurement-validity keystone is NOT_INSPECTED; conditional on it, the existing 850-volume download plan is manageable.

data_readiness.why: Pair metadata are inspected, but images and checkpoints are gated and the measurement tool does not natively consume the released representation.

evaluation_readiness.why: Paired slopes and clustered intervals are standard, but reliability, minimum-effect, and equivalence margins still require prospective specification.

negative_result_value.why: After measurement and power gates pass, a confidence interval within a frozen equivalence margin decisively bounds material coupling for the tested contrasts.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped by the uninspected keystone and limited because the exact 2025-2026 overlap search is incomplete.

regret.why: The natural pairs are unusually clean and reusable, but the surviving claim is modest and shares assets with idea 004.
